title: Crisp Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and spicy North African-inspired chicken dish with a crunchy twist. This recipe combines the rich flavors of a traditional tagine with a crunchy, crispy exterior.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, cumin, coriander, and paprika.
Dredge the chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the chicken until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, heat the crushed tomatoes in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper (if using) to the tomatoes and stir to combine.
When the chicken is done, add it to the saucepan and simmer for 5-7 minutes to coat with the sauce.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
